department: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE)

deadline.value: School of CEE August 2027 intake application period runs 1 October to 28 February (later than NTU's central 31 January deadline; January intake closes 31 July).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for civil or environmental engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: NTU strongly recommends contacting a potential supervisor before applying; otherwise the School assigns a supervisor based on research interests.
supervisor.quote: It is highly recommended that you seek out a potential supervisor prior to submitting your application. Alternatively, if you have not identified one, the School will appoint a supervisor based on your research interests.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: Research Scholarships | Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship | NTU Research Scholarship | Provost Graduate Award

also.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD admission from a good Honours bachelor's degree (preferably at least Second Class Upper / Honours Distinction).
entry_route.quote: Applicants should possess a good Honours degree, preferably at least Second Class Honours (Upper Division) or Honours (Distinction), and demonstrate the ability to undertake research in their proposed field of study.

notes: CEE offers a school-specific August intake deadline of 28 February (vs 31 January centrally).
